notes: One active goal per user at a time. A goal window starts when the agent commits to the goal. All times are UTC unless a field says IST.

goals.name: first_play_24h
goals.description: A new user starts any episode within 24 hours.

eligibility.text: Signed up in the last 7 days and has never started a play.

goals.name: first_full_episode_3d
goals.description: The user finishes a whole episode (90% or more) for the first time.

goals.name: second_day_return_2d
goals.description: A new user comes back on a second day.

eligibility.text: Signed up in the last 2 days.

success.condition: on a later IST calendar day than the goal start

goals.name: trial_to_paid_7d
goals.description: A user on a trial moves to a paid plan.

goals.name: first_paid_7d
goals.description: A user who has never paid buys a first paid plan.

eligibility.text: Has never had a paid plan.

goals.name: reactivate_lapsed_14d
goals.description: A recently lapsed subscriber buys again.

goals.name: resume_series_3d
goals.description: The user continues a series they left unfinished.

eligibility.text: Started a show or micro-drama, has unwatched episodes left, and has not played it for 3 or more days.

success.condition: same content_slug as the unfinished series

goals.name: try_new_release_7d
goals.description: A subscriber plays a recent release.

success.condition: a title released in the 30 days before the goal start

goals.name: weekly_habit_14d
goals.description: A subscriber who rarely watches builds a habit.

eligibility.text: Active subscriber with plays on at most 1 day in the last 14 days.

goals.name: meaningful_engagement_7d
goals.description: The user engages meaningfully with the app.

goals.name: tv_activation_14d
goals.description: A subscriber starts watching on the TV app.

goals.name: return_after_absence_7d
goals.description: A user who had stopped visiting plays again.

eligibility.text: No app_open in the 14 days before the trigger.
